name: @systemfsoftware/xstate-store
author: Ryan Lee <drdgvhbh@gmail.com>
description: Event-driven stores with selectors, undo, persistence and validation — forked under systemfsoftware from statelyai/xstate (@xstate/store at 2146ae26).

scripts.lint:tsgo: effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.app.json --format ${TSGO_FORMAT:-text} && effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.test.json --format ${TSGO_FORMAT:-text}
scripts.api:check: api-extractor-quiet run && api-extractor-quiet run --config api-extractor.persist.json && api-extractor-quiet run --config api-extractor.reset.json && api-extractor-quiet run --config api-extractor.undo.json && api-extractor-quiet run --config api-extractor.validate.json
scripts.api:update: api-extractor run --local && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.persist.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.reset.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.undo.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.validate.json
